name: Autobadge (/autobadge)
makes: Makes a Talent Contest video badge: a tuxedo portrait from the user's photo (one Seedream 5.5 image) and their name, built into a 10.333 s vertical 1080x1920 video by a bundled script.

steps.name: Portrait
steps.cheap: `seedream_5_0_flash` 2k: 0.5 credits a picture quoted, against 1.75-2.5 for 2k pictures

prompts.label: Portrait prompt (verbatim in the request)
prompts.text: Studio portrait of the same person from the reference photo wearing a black tuxedo, white shirt and black bow tie, chest-up, centered, facing camera, pure black background, soft studio key light, white rim light from behind along the hair and shoulders, bottom of the frame fading to black.

prompts.label: Portrait request
Name check command
prompts.text:
mkdir -p ~/autobadge/<run> && cd ~/autobadge/<run> && cat > name.txt <<'AUTOBADGE_NAME'
<the name, exactly as typed>
AUTOBADGE_NAME
python3 "$HF_WORKFLOWS/autobadge/scripts/autobadge.py" --name-file name.txt --check-name

prompts.label: Build command
prompts.text:
cd ~/autobadge/<run> \
  && python3 "$HF_WORKFLOWS/autobadge/scripts/autobadge.py" --portrait portrait.img --name-file name.txt --out out \
  && <the PUT command of the autobadge.mp4 slot, with out/autobadge.mp4 as the file> \
  && <the PUT command of the autobadge_phone.mp4 slot, with out/autobadge_phone.mp4 as the file>

price: Quotes with `get_cost` before the one image; the command's own sample line reads 'Seedream 5.5: about 2.5 credits'. Build is free. One badge is about 2.5 credits; a new name on the same portrait is free.
